soundness_flags.label: def:primitive-correlations and all downstream uses of s_m, d_m, and R_m
soundness_flags.one_line: Because d may exceed n, X has no ambient Lebesgue density; define scores and expectations explicitly on the deterministic common support with its induced Gaussian measure, replacing the undefined notation E_P[· | m=0] by E_{P_0}[·].

soundness_flags.label: thm:strict-margin-improvement
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed strict recovery-region tightening compares only eta_global, while Acartürk et al.'s graph theorem also requires its separate gamma-star condition; state and transfer the full published premise to both reached bands before claiming strict finite-sample-region inclusion.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:promised-transcript-certificate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The recovery guarantee is conditional on the novel reached-eigenvalue and reached-projector gap promise and is an exact-real statistical result.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Field-tier conditional claim: under the stated transcript-local gap and covariance-conditioning class, the certificate recovers the environment-labelled closure and encoder range; it is not a result for arbitrary CRL laws or a finite-bit implementation.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: proposal-level tier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The flagship-looking novelty is a sufficient recovery class defined through assumed transcript-local gaps, rather than a derived necessary frontier.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Tier is capped at field; the strict result may compare sufficient classes for the fixed public program, not characterize all successful causal-representation learners.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 6, equation (22); p. 8, Theorem 3; p. 19, Lemma 13; pp. 16–17, equations (81)–(90)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Equation (22) defines eta-star as the minimum nonzero eigenvalue over M subseteq [n]; Theorem 3 uses eta-star and gamma-star for graph recovery. The appendix prints the subset-pseudoinverse assertion in equation (83).

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–4, contribution summary and score-based methodology; p. 38, Theorem 14 discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper presents LSCALE-I and states that one soft intervention per node recovers the transitive closure and representations up to ancestor mixing in the linear setting.

The source specifies linear SEMs with diagonal noise scaling, injective linear mixing, and perfect single-node interventions; it states one intervention per latent node is sufficient, and worst-case necessary, for graph recovery.
The paper develops time-uniform nonasymptotic confidence sequences and explicitly includes matrix martingales and covariance-matrix estimation applications.

The paper studies finite-sample CRL with logarithmically many unknown multi-node interventions and recovery of graph, mixing, representations, and targets; it is adjacent rather than a same-class comparator.
The proceedings paper identifies the full-version Corollary 4.5 as a deterministic spectral-projector routine for invariant subspaces of Hermitian-definite pencils.
The paper gives polynomial bit-complexity algorithms for approximate Jordan normal form and polynomial spectral factorization, supporting only the stated bit-growth-template role.

The paper studies strong-faithfulness geometrically and shows that non-strong-faithful distributions can have substantial volume; it does not establish the proposal's score-correlation transcript separation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define all scores, gradients, inverse operators, and expectations in the fixed n-dimensional support coordinates, and make the support-batch probability-one event explicit in the theorem.
Rewrite Theorem 3 against Acartürk et al.'s complete eta-star plus gamma-star sufficient premise, prove that it implies both reached bands, and then use the witness family for strict inclusion.

Add a finite-dimensional worked transcript for the Gaussian family, including every queried subset, its rank/projector decision, and the unqueried {3,4} calculation, so the strict separation is independently auditable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the support-level score definition and the full Acartürk comparator premise, then continue this field-tier transcript-local recovery angle to Stage 0.
